title: 001 Jennifer McIntosh at ISCH 2015.jpg
author: Hemmers
description:
Jennifer McIntosh in the 10m Air Rifle Final at the 2015 International Shooting Competition of Hannover in Germany.

The air rifle is a Pardini GPR1 match air rifle.

ISCH is held annually at Niedersächsischer Sportschützenverband.
